title: Arthur Durbin's and other New Orleans bands booked into Pensacola
summary: The undertaker booked New Orleans bands, with Sadie on piano; she recalls Arthur Durbin's band and Kid Rena.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: interest. I wanted to ask you, Sadie, you mentioned that Buddy Petit's band came through Pensacola. There were several others from New Orleans that came through there?
Well we had an Undertaker who used to book all the bands out of New Orleans there. And I always was the piano player with them.
Do you remember some of the other people that came from New Orleans?

I know some of the guys. Arthur Durbin, he played trumpet. He brought a band there but I can't think of all the guys that he brought with him. I remember Arthur Durbin, let me see now, who else can I say? Since so long. Do you remember Renee being there?
I think I have. I remember that name Renee. Kid Renee? Yeah, Kid Renee. I remember him. And we were playing drums at the time.
And we had a guy who played bass Eddie.

His name was Eddie from Ovin L.G. And then we had a fellow playing Simmons, he played Clannett with Arthur Durbin. Where was your name? And I remember him. And I remember him. And we had a guy who played bass Eddie. His name was Eddie from Ovin L.G. And then we had a fellow playing Simmons, he played Clannett with Arthur Durbin. Where was he from? Over in Al Jays. Simeon? Yeah. Simeon? Yeah. That's his name, a little short, a little short, a little short, very fair, yeah. He was a Creole guy, he was short, very short, wasn't much taller than me. And he played Clannett. Was it his band? Yeah it was his band. It was Arthur Durbin's band. He brought them. Now he used to have a cigar place where he used to make cigars here in New Orleans, Arthur did. But he played music too. And let me see now, who else was there? And they had a guy named Sawyer. Sawyer some played drums with him. It's been so long. I don't know Sawyer's last name but I know his name. And he's a guy named Sawyer. He's a guy named Sawyer. Sawyer some played drums with him. And he's all with Buddy now. Yeah these were with Arthur Durbin. This was a different band. Oh Arthur Durbin. Arthur Durbin's band. Did you play with Arthur Durbin's band?
Yeah. So they would never bring it?

No they didn't know. They never brought a piano player? Yeah, Hunter Tech always had me to play piano there. And where did Arthur Durbin play then? He played trumpet. He played trumpet. Did you ever know him to play another instrument? No I never did know, unless he played after he came back to New Orleans. He did, he played saxophone. Yeah. You know a lot of people quit trumpet. That hurt their lip or something. They had to quit. Oh I see. Well anyway, all the bands would be booked there, the Undertaker would book them there, from out of New Orleans. I always was a piano player with them. Now Buddy Petit was the one that, that was the last one I played with in Pensacola. Because he kept on asking me why I'm going to come to New Orleans and they said you're such a good piano player, you come on New Orleans. So I said okay. So Chani, when I went to go in with Chani, then Chani sent for me when he came back here, Chani Bebe.
